Pages, like on paper, with the layout of the original. Text flows to the width of the screen, easier to read on a phone. You can switch at any time in the document.
Opens again only from that app

This shelf is empty. Long-press a document on “All” and choose “Shelves…” to put it here.
Documents kept inside Hramota live here. Books arrive by themselves; any other document — through ⋮ → “Keep in Hramota”. Files you only opened are in Recent, and their bookmarks are remembered too.

Document memory, shelves, covers, kept copies and the recent list are encrypted with a key held in the phone’s secure hardware. Opening Hramota then asks for the phone’s screen lock; it locks again a minute after you leave. If the screen lock is removed, the locked data cannot be opened.

A new DOCX file is made; the old one stays as it is. Text, formatting, tables, pictures in the text, headers, footers and page size carry over; list numbers become text. Footnotes, comments, link addresses, text boxes, floating shapes, pictures in headers and nested tables do not; tab stops become left ones, and all sections take one orientation.

A new XLSX file is made; the old one stays as it is. Values, the look of cells, column widths, merged cells and hidden sheets carry over. Formulas keep only their results and the font becomes Calibri; charts, pictures and cell comments do not carry over.
No bookmarks or notes yet. A bookmark goes where you are with the ribbon at the top; a note, on words you select.

The idea of making handy Ukrainian apps that ask for as few permissions as possible and work well offline came while I was working at my laptop in near darkness: after yet another Russian drone attack, the power was gone again. That is how Hramota began: your documents and books should open anywhere, with no cloud and no one else\'s servers.

Hramota is free software: its code is open, and anyone can check what it does. No ads, no tracking, no accounts. Freedom in software is not a small thing. It is the right to know what happens on your phone, and not to hand your life to anyone.

Hramota was made in Ukraine 🇺🇦. The occupiers destroy Ukrainian libraries and books. Let us read our own: the classics, today\'s writers, our history. This is who we are, and it is alive. We are alive.

Yet since 2014, and since 24 February 2022 at full force, Russia has been waging war against my country. Every day, missiles and drones strike cities, homes, hospitals and power plants. The occupiers kill, abduct Ukrainian children, destroy museums, churches and libraries, and ban our language in the lands they hold. Their aim is for Ukrainians to cease to exist as a people.
We are fighting for the right to be: to live on our own land, speak our own language, create our own things. The freedom you value in software is, for us today, a matter of life.
If Hramota is useful to you, please support Ukraine. I receive none of this money: the links go straight to the organisations\' official sites.
If you are from Ukraine: thank you for being here. We hold on. We defend, we donate, we look after one another and we choose Ukrainian: together, this brings victory closer.
The links open in your browser, on the organisations\' own sites. The app knows nothing about it and receives nothing.

Delete every sample of your handwriting? Recognition will no longer be tuned to it.

Hramota recognises handwriting with a general model trained on no one\'s personal writing. What you write here tunes recognition to your hand, on this phone only: the samples are never sent anywhere and are encrypted with locked storage on. If you wish to help make recognition better for everyone, you can save them to a file and share it yourself.
